hero.title: Guardian Scraper
hero.subtitle: One page, a list of titles.
hero.tagline: A Node script that fetches the Guardian UK front and prints each headline with its link.
hero.impact: Axios downloads the HTML. Cheerio reads every .fc-item__title. The title text and the anchor href are pushed into an array and logged.

problems.d: The URL is https://www.theguardian.com/uk. Axios gets the HTML. There is no JSON feed in this script.
Cheerio loads the HTML and walks .fc-item__title. Each node’s text is the title. The nested anchor’s href is stored with it.
The array is console.log’d when the request finishes. Failures log the error.
Express is created and listens on port 8000. The scrape runs once at startup. No route returns the list.
